items.title: Millions of Spaniards stage first general strike in 14 years as anger rages over housing
items.brief: Four million Spanish workers took part in a general strike on Wednesday, unions said, enduring stormy weather to set up picket lines in a protest against the country’s housing affordability crisis less than three…

items.title: Clinging to life and crying, a baby was found buried alive a day after his father took him, investigators say
items.brief: Trapped in a dog crate and entombed beneath a foot of dirt, a South Carolina infant miraculously survived 24 hours buried underground, authorities say.

items.title: Video shows soldier reprimanding Hegseth and advisers at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
items.brief: A US Army sentinel guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier reprimanded Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and a group of his senior advisers Wednesday after some in the group laughed and talked near the solemn memorial…

items.title: See which 11 Democrats missed the Pete Hegseth impeachment vote
items.brief: The House of Representatives voted on Tuesday evening to send an effort to impeach Pete Hegseth to committee, effectively killing the movement to oust the defense secretary before the end of the year.

items.title: Russian ambassador to US dies suddenly, foreign ministry says
items.brief: Russia’s ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, died in Moscow aged 66, the Russian Foreign Ministry said on Wednesday.

items.title: Bomb threat hoaxes prompt evacuation of Italian schools, alarm in UK and Ireland
items.brief: Hundreds of schools across Italy were evacuated on Wednesday after bomb threats were sent to about 6,300 institutions, becoming the latest in a series of incidents targeting infrastructure across Europe.

items.title: How the Jayson Tatum-Jaylen Brown beef turned a November game into an NBA Finals-esque atmosphere
items.brief: It’s rare for a November game to feel like a Game 7 playoff tilt, but Tuesday night’s showdown in Philadelphia between the 76ers and Boston Celtics certainly delivered that kind of electric atmosphere in spades.
